title: Import Preview
description: Catches a bad spreadsheet import before it lands by finding the real heading row (skipping title lines, flagging headings about to be imported as a record), matching columns by heading and by their values with a confidence, holding the import while a required field is unmapped, and listing every skipped line by its spreadsheet line number and reason (duplicates in the file and against existing records, repeated headings, bad values) before a plain "Import 412 · skip 7".
stops: Bad CSV import created junk records
